[patterns/application/extensions/README.md#overview]

## Overview

This directory contains architectural patterns for implementing customer-funded product customizations in a sustainable, scalable manner. These patterns support the [Customer-Funded Product Customization Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/customer-funded-customization-strategy.md) by providing standardized approaches for extending products without accumulating technical debt or compromising product integrity.
page_texts.3:
[patterns/application/extensions/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Enable customer-specific functionality through well-architected extension mechanisms that:
- Maintain separation between core product and customizations
- Support independent evolution and upgrade paths
- Enable multi-tenant deployments with customer-specific logic
- Manage diverse intellectual property ownership models
- Provide consistent development experience for DDI teams

[patterns/application/extensions/README.md#target-audience]

## Target Audience

- **Product Engineering Teams**: Architecting products for extensibility
- **DDI Implementation Teams**: Developing customer customizations
- **Enterprise Architects**: Designing extension frameworks
- **Product Managers**: Understanding customization capabilities and constraints

## Patterns in this Category

| Pattern ID | Name | Purpose | Priority |
|------------|------|---------|----------|
| [PTN-APP-EXT-001](./PTN-APP-EXT-001-plugin-architecture-pattern.md) | **Plugin Architecture** | Isolate customer code through plugin interfaces and dynamic loading | High |

| [PTN-APP-EXT-007](./PTN-APP-EXT-007-entity-framework-extensibility-pattern.md) | **Entity Framework Extensibility** | Extend data models without forking core entities | Medium |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-008](./PTN-APP-EXT-008-compatibility-testing-pattern.md) | **Compatibility Testing** | Validate extension compatibility across product versions | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-009](./PTN-APP-EXT-009-isolation-testing-pattern.md) | **Isolation Testing** | Verify extensions don't affect other tenants or stability | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-010](./PTN-APP-EXT-010-rule-engine-extension-pattern.md) | **Rule Engine Extension** | Use configurable rules instead of code where appropriate | Medium |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-011](./PTN-APP-EXT-011-workflow-customization-pattern.md) | **Workflow Customization** | Extend workflows with state-specific process variations | Medium |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-012](./PTN-APP-EXT-012-react-component-extension-pattern.md) | **React Component Extension** | Extend React applications with custom components and hooks | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-013](./PTN-APP-EXT-013-module-federation-extension-pattern.md) | **Module Federation Extension** | Dynamically load micro-frontend extensions using Webpack Module Federation | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-014](./PTN-APP-EXT-014-ui-extension-point-registration-pattern.md) | **UI Extension Point Registration** | Register and render UI extensions at designated extension points | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-015](./PTN-APP-EXT-015-micro-frontend-compatibility-testing-pattern.md) | **Micro-Frontend Compatibility Testing** | Validate micro-frontend extensions remain compatible across host versions | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-016](./PTN-APP-EXT-016-micro-frontend-isolation-testing-pattern.md) | **Micro-Frontend Isolation Testing** | Verify extensions don't pollute global scope or affect other tenants | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-017](./PTN-APP-EXT-017-extension-design-system-integration-pattern.md) | **Extension Design System Integration** | Integrate extensions with host design system for UI consistency | High |
| [PTN-APP-EXT-018](./PTN-APP-EXT-018-extension-state-management-integration-pattern.md) | **Extension State Management Integration** | Manage state communication between host and extensions | High |

[patterns/application/extensions/README.md#key-principles]

## Key Principles

1. **Separation of Concerns**: Core product capabilities remain independent of customer-specific customizations through architectural boundaries
2. **Configuration Over Customization**: Maximize capabilities delivered through configuration and parameterization before resorting to custom code
3. **Open Extension Points**: Provide well-defined, versioned extension points that enable customer functionality without modifying core product code
4. **Governance-First**: All customization requests evaluated through structured decision framework

[patterns/application/extensions/README.md#success-metrics]

## Success Metrics

- **Technical Debt Reduction**: 50% reduction in customization-related technical debt within 24 months
- **Upgrade Simplification**: 40% reduction in product upgrade complexity
- **Development Efficiency**: 30% faster customization development using SDK
- **Multi-Tenant Enablement**: Support customer-specific functionality in shared environments
- **Contribution-Back Success**: 20%+ of eligible customizations enriching core product

[patterns/application/extensions/README.md#getting-started]

## Getting Started

1. **Review Strategy**: Read the [Customer-Funded Product Customization Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/customer-funded-customization-strategy.md)
2. **Understand Patterns**: Start with PTN-APP-EXT-001 (Plugin Architecture) and PTN-APP-EXT-002 (Extension Points)
3. **Evaluate Customizations**: Use PTN-GOV-CUS-001 (Decision Framework) to assess new requests
4. **Build Extensions**: Leverage PTN-APP-EXT-005 (.NET SDK) for implementation
